scope: Enrich SBQuantum and Quantum Algorithms Institute with decision-relevant technical, financing, procurement and partnership context; retain unresolved access and performance limits for individual human review.

prospects.name: SBQuantum
prospects.fitSummary: Assess SBQuantum operating context for nitrogen-vacancy diamond magnetometers using National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency evaluation evidence and the MagAware award; verify accepted performance before considering navigation integration.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: SBQuantum presents nitrogen-vacancy diamond magnetometers and magnetic mapping for navigation, security screening and mapping; public sales contact is info@sbquantum.com.

The MagAware award identifies 13717658 CANADA INC as SBQuantum/SBQ at 805 rue Galt Ouest, suite 204, Sherbrooke. CW2445882 was awarded April 14, 2026, ends October 26, 2026 and lists CAD 2,237,475.24 total value, PSPC as contracting organization and ISED as buyer.

NGA identifies SBQuantum and Spire as the diamond-magnetometer CubeSat team. Geomagnetic data will be compared with WMM2025, and evaluation will inform a future magnetic-data acquisition strategy for WMM2030.

Quantonation confirms its participation alongside Quantacet and Investissement Québec in SBQuantum financing; its sector discussion stresses integration, robustness and magnetic maps as adoption requirements.

SBQuantum presents an SBQ Diamond Magnetometer configuration of 15 x 5 x 5 cm, 400 g and 4 W, with vector sensitivity below 1 nT/sqrt(Hz) at 1 Hz and 40 Hz bandwidth. Its later performance roadmap distinguishes configurations; navigation also requires magnetic maps, noise compensation and algorithms. These are company specifications, not independent navigation acceptance.

prospects.name: Quantum Algorithms Institute
prospects.fitSummary: Assess Quantum Algorithms Institute operating context and funding partnerships using British Columbia Investment Management Corporation collaboration evidence; determine whether intended readiness work and current funding access meet a prospective partner’s needs.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: QAI says a strategic review shifted its work from direct program delivery toward funding partnerships, research translation and commercialization across British Columbia.

BCI and QAI announced work on portfolio optimization, risk assessment and financial modelling, alongside post-quantum security standards. The announcement describes intended work and broader learning; it does not report completed implementation or measured quantum advantage.

Western Economic Diversification Canada announced CAD 2.21 million to establish QAI at SFU Surrey, supporting a physical collaboration hub, events, commercialization and business adoption. Its training and commercialization counts were expected outcomes, not achieved results.
